metadata.description: ennyn: a measured development loop for coding agents (one plugin).

plugins.name: ennyn
plugins.description: A Claude Code plugin and Node CLI that gives the agent a working routine: impact analysis before code is written, a two-round review, and checks on every commit for recurring classes of bugs. In every session its hooks record the plugin's version in the plugin's own data folder; everything else they do only in a project with an Ennyn config (.ennyn/config.json, or the file ENNYN_CONFIG names): pass the project's path-scoped rules into worktrees and copies, apply the conversation style you chose, refuse every git push but a plain one the ask rule reads for certain, refuse a kill chosen by a filter, a name, a window title, a port or a PID looked up at run time, hold idle compaction while a task is mid-way, ask every summary to name the task, its files and the next step, and after a compaction ask the agent to re-read the task's changed files and impact table (`compaction.defer: false` turns these three off).
